answer: Standing is a comet that only appears when a stranger says thank you: each epoch’s work must be thanked by an established stranger who explains how it helped them — a walnut only cracks when a stranger says thank you, and a bridge only counts when strangers cross it to say thank you. A farm of a thousand fakes is thanked by no stranger: only its own members thank each other, so their comets never appear, and one epoch of unthanked work adds nothing.
